theme: Yesterday agents sat inside already-open tools. Today they get an execution model, a knowledge factory, and a bill: Claude Code writes JavaScript to chain tools, Harrison Chase tells companies to curate tacit knowledge instead of spawning more agents, Stripe says Link Agent Wallet spend is ~80x early September, and US banks push the liability onto customers. Waddle-1 takes the same loop onto two robot arms; Arcfront sells the judgment traces those agents still lack.
